newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton market closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton market closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: The Bombay cotton market closed on Monday for Holi, the Hindu festival of colours. The market will reopen on Tuesday.
In spot deals on Friday Bengal-deshi fell 10 rupees at 870/920 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned dropped by 10/35 rupees to 1,525/1,650 rupees per maund.
F-414 slid by 5 rupees to 1,920/1,935 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan rose to 13,000/13,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) from 12,600/13,000 rupees.
